reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-10-29 issuer asset-composition page supersedes the October 15 payload. The dashboard last_updated is 2026-10-29T12:08:46.361Z; the page was captured 2026-10-29T18:21Z and re-read live at 2026-10-29T18:29:04Z with identical values. Exact asset_classes values total USD 69,046,922.14880197: cash_fiat USD 706,967.2693321748 (1.023893965626158%), stablecoins USD 11,946,230.11708977 (17.30161134676595%), liquid_hedge USD 52,639,744.35782912 gross (76.23764060675437%), staked_lst USD 2,820,199.680895238 (4.084468348665085%) and tbill_rwa USD 933,780.7236556622 (1.352385732188446%). The class values sum to that total, which equals overview.total_reserves and the 2026-10-29 reserves_history point; supply USD 68,864,099.65676695 and the reported 100.27 collateralization ratio reconcile. Within liquid hedge inventory the issuer marks USD 33,662,245.1926844 across 462 of 494 assets as unclassified, equal to 48.75270923755212% of the whole book and 63.94834474092161% of the class. The five class identities, names and asset classes are reviewed; the named examples establish no exhaustive constituent, obligor, venue share, maturity or enforceable liquidity term. Liquid hedge inventory remains assetClass other rather than a reclassified cryptoasset, and the unclassified portion is one keyed insufficient-evidence residual instead of being hidden in the class or split into invented categories. Weights are measured by the live adapter; this classification-only review certifies class, obligor and risk metadata, not whole-book composition.

The remaining 51.24729076244788% is identified only at the five issuer asset-class level: constituent identities, venue and obligor shares, hedge notional, maturity, legal ownership and enforceable liquidity or recovery remain undisclosed and are not inferred. Class examples such as BTC, ETH, SOL, xNVDA, stETH, bnSOL, USYC and USDG establish no constituent weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer explicitly marks USD 33,662,245.1926844 across 462 of 494 liquid-hedge assets as unclassified, and names no asset, venue or obligor for that portion. It carries no maturity or enforceable liquidity term, so it cannot be attached to a tracked coin or admitted as a classified reserve slice. The amount stays visible as the single keyed residual; splitting it or inferring constituent classes would invent evidence.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The deposit address is an entry point, not a whole-book custodian. Docs say no current off-exchange custody, while the October 15 dashboard assigns 2.08% to qualified custody and 0.98% to onchain derivatives margin. The dashboard calls location ratios working management classifications pending Finance and Risk validation. This contradiction remains unresolved, so custodyModel stays unknown rather than a whole-book CEX or institutional tier. Location percentages are not named-provider shares or legal segregation evidence; no share is assigned to the deposit address or a guessed venue.
